questions.comprehension_passage: SEARCH The figure shows a map with several locations on a grid where each tile is 1x1 in size. The locations are at grid points and are connected by two-way edges. Take S as the start node and G as the goal node. The MoveGen function returns neighbours in alphabetical order. The RemoveSeen procedure removes neighbours already present in OPEN/CLOSED lists.
